name: The Deep Gallery

text: The last stretch of cart road anyone bothered to keep.
It runs to the edge of the water and stops.
Three galleries below this one are the water.
A pump house, or what a pump house leaves behind.
Bolt holes in the floor in the shape of something enormous,
and a bill of sale nailed to the rock. Sold. Not replaced.
A survey stake driven into the gallery floor, brass-capped, new.
MERIDIAN FOUNDATION - GEOLOGICAL. DO NOT DISTURB.
Somebody has disturbed it. Somebody has bent it right over.
A desk, a lamp, a kettle and a folding cot, sixty fathom down.
Whoever works here does not think of it as being underground.
Whoever works here thinks of it as being at work.

_plan: Roxen's Hall is her office at the bottom of her own mine, and the room says so: a desk, a kettle and a cot at sixty fathom. The flooded middle of the gallery is why the route round is a ring rather than a straight walk, and the Meridian survey stake at 13,5 is the first thing in the game that puts the Foundation somewhere it was not invited. The man-engine at 3,1 is one-way up to the Hall, so nobody re-walks the workings after winning.
